Claim 1 (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition, wherein the physiological monitor is located at a patient location; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor at a central monitoring location, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from the first alarm in at least one of intensity, frequency, or modality.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to manage escalation of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and an escalation status; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the system is configured to differentiate between alarms triggered at different locations.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system, and wherein the system is configured to communicate alarm information between the physiological monitor and the central management system.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm, and wherein the level of escalation is based on acknowledgement status and elapsed time.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, including which of multiple alarm sources acknowledged the alarm.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices only after a predetermined escalation threshold has been reached.
